description: The Jr. Welding Technician course is a short-term, skill-based program designed to prepare students for careers in industries such as manufacturing, automotive, and heavy engineering. It also opens up opportunities for students to start their own welding-related businesses. The curriculum includes essential topics such as industrial safety, welding techniques, safety precautions during welding, and documentation of welding processes.Students will gain hands-on experience performing TIG and MIG welding using dedicated welding guns. They will learn to execute various types of joints including T-joints, lap joints, and butt joints, even on complex parts and under diverse scenarios. The course also covers machine setup, including welding torch configuration, high-pressure cylinder and regulator handling, basic troubleshooting, and maintenance of welding equipment. Students will also learn about welding quality standards and inspection procedures.A key highlight of the course is the integration of Augmented Reality (AR) and Virtual Reality (VR) through XR station simulators, allowing students to practice welding in immersive, simulated environments. This method eliminates the need for consumables, making the training cost-effective, safe, and environmentally friendly. After completing a welding task, students can use specialized software to evaluate the quality of their welds, checking for coverage accuracy, joint integrity, and overall weld performance, ensuring a complete and measurable learning experience.
